Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Super admin credential and authorization entry

User.title: User
User.description: User profile with role, event assignments, and company credentials

uid.description: The user's unique Firebase Auth ID

assignedEvents.description: List of event IDs assigned to this user

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Event definition created and managed by an Event Manager or Company Owner

ownerUid.description: UID of the Event Manager or Owner who created the event

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the event manager or creator

ticketTypes.description: Available ticket tiers/types configured by manager

customFields.description: Up to 5 custom check-in fields (id, label, type: text|boolean)

marketingChannels.description: Configured marketing and publication channels (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn)

assignedPhotographers.description: List of photographer objects with email, status, and optional uid

photographerEmails.description: Indexed list of assigned photographer email addresses

photographerUids.description: Indexed list of assigned photographer UIDs

Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: Master photograph metadata stored in top-level photos table with event_id reference

eventId.description: Associated event ID (foreign key reference to Event)

event_id.description: Relational column alias for associated event ID

uploadedBy.description: UID of the photographer or manager who uploaded

storagePath.description: Firebase / Google Cloud Storage location path

matchedAttendees.description: Array of matched attendee IDs from CV face matching pipeline

detectedFaceEmbeddings.description: Array of 512-dimensional feature vectors extracted from detected faces for KNN matching

clearedStoragePath.description: Storage location of privacy-cleared marketing image with non-consenting faces blurred

clearedDownloadUrl.description: Public URL of privacy-cleared marketing image

rawStoragePath.description: Restricted original high-res storage path preserved for future AI-face regeneration

hasBlurredFaces.description: Flag indicating if one or more non-consenting or unconfirmed faces were redacted

deleteOn.description: Optional scheduled deletion date timestamp for event media cleanup

Attendee.title: Attendee
Attendee.description: Attendee check-in submission record with event_id reference and facial embedding

eventId.description: Identifier of the event checked into (foreign key reference to Event)

event_id.description: Relational column alias for associated event ID

fullName.description: Attendee full legal or badge name

customResponses.description: Key-value responses corresponding to event custom fields

consentGiven.description: Explicit required agreement to data processing and retention

photoConsentGiven.description: Unified consent to photo identification and tagging

allowedMarketingChannels.description: Granular list of channels attendee explicitly allowed their photos to appear in

checkInPhotoPath.description: Firebase Storage path of optional check-in selfie, or null

checkInPhotoUrl.description: Download or preview URL of check-in selfie

photoEmbedding.description: 512-dimensional numerical facial feature embedding vector used for KNN nearest-neighbor similarity search

deleteOn.description: Scheduled deletion date timestamp for automated database cleanup and vector purge (enforces 30-day retention window)

/users/{userId}.description: Master Users table: profiles, roles, and event assignments independent of single events

/events/{eventId}.description: Master Events table: event configuration, schedule, ticket tiers, and assigned personnel

/photos/{photoId}.description: Master Photos table: all company event photos with eventId/event_id column for global search and filtering

/attendees/{attendeeId}.description: Master Attendees table: all attendee check-in records with eventId/event_id column

/events/{eventId}/attendees/{attendeeId}.description: Scoped attendee check-in subcollection (maintained for backward compatibility)

/events/{eventId}/photos/{photoId}.description: Scoped event photo subcollection (maintained for backward compatibility)
